intro: 本章只讲非线性**电阻**电路。方程不再是线性的，叠加定理不再成立；但线性部分仍然可以用戴维宁定理化简。
核心是**工作点**：用曲线相交（负载线）、解析或分段线性的方法求出它，再用动态电阻做小信号分析。
最重要的习惯：每求出一个解，都回到特性的适用范围里检验一次。

ideas.title: 非线性电阻及其分类
text: - 一个电阻的 v–i 关系不是过原点的直线，它就是**非线性电阻**。图形符号是电阻方框上加一条带短横的斜线。
- 它仍然**没有记忆**：某一时刻的电流只由同一时刻的电压决定。所以本章的电路仍是电阻电路，只是方程不再线性。
- **压控型**：i 是 v 的单值函数，i = f(v)。隧道二极管的 N 形曲线就是这样：同一个电流可以对应几个电压。
- **流控型**：v 是 i 的单值函数，v = h(i)，例如充气管的 S 形曲线。**单调**的特性（普通二极管、i = v + v³）两种都算。
- **双向**电阻的曲线关于原点对称，f(−v) = −f(v)，两个端子可以互换。二极管是**单向**的：接反了，电路的工作完全不同（面包板 5.1 里亲眼见过）。

en.title: Nonlinear resistors and their classification
text: - A resistor whose v–i relation is not a straight line through the origin is a **nonlinear resistor**. Its symbol is a resistor box crossed by a slanted line with a short bar.
- It still has **no memory**: the current at any instant depends only on the voltage at that instant. So the circuits in this chapter are still resistive; only the equations are no longer linear.
- **Voltage-controlled**: i is a single-valued function of v, i = f(v). A tunnel diode's N-shaped curve is one: one current can belong to several voltages.
- **Current-controlled**: v is a single-valued function of i, v = h(i), like a gas tube's S-shaped curve. A **monotonic** characteristic (an ordinary diode, i = v + v³) is both.

- A **bilateral** resistor's curve is symmetric about the origin, f(−v) = −f(v), so its terminals can be swapped. A diode is **unilateral**: connected the other way, the circuit behaves completely differently (you saw it on the breadboard in 5.1).

ideas.title: 静态电阻与动态电阻
text: - 工作点 Q(V_Q，I_Q) 处有两种电阻。**静态电阻** R = V_Q/I_Q，是 Q 和原点连线的斜率。
- **动态电阻** R_d = dv/di|_{Q}，是 Q 点切线的斜率。动态电导 G_d = 1/R_d。两者都随工作点变化；只有线性电阻处处 R = R_d。
- 静态电阻用来算工作点的功率和比值。动态电阻描述**变化量**：Δv ≈ R_d·Δi。
- 曲线下降的一段 R_d < 0，叫**负动态电阻**。这时元件仍在吸收功率（V_Q·I_Q > 0），只是电压升高时电流反而减小。
- 曲线水平的地方 R_d = ∞，竖直的地方 R_d = 0。

en.title: Static and dynamic resistance
text: - At the operating point Q(V_Q, I_Q) there are two resistances. The **static resistance** R = V_Q/I_Q is the slope of the line from the origin to Q.

- The **dynamic resistance** R_d = dv/di at Q is the slope of the tangent at Q; the dynamic conductance is G_d = 1/R_d. Both change with the operating point; only a linear resistor has R = R_d everywhere.
- Use the static resistance for power and ratios at the operating point. The dynamic resistance describes **changes**: Δv ≈ R_d·Δi.
- On a falling part of the curve R_d < 0: **negative dynamic resistance**. The element still absorbs power (V_Q·I_Q > 0); the current just drops when the voltage rises.
- Where the curve is horizontal R_d = ∞; where it is vertical R_d = 0.

ideas.title: 非线性电阻的串联与并联
text: - **串联**：电流相同，电压相加。在**同一个 i** 下把各条曲线的 v 加起来（横着叠），v = h_1(i) + h_2(i)。
- **并联**：电压相同，电流相加。在**同一个 v** 下把 i 加起来（竖着叠），i = f_1(v) + f_2(v)。
- 写成式子相加时，函数形式要配得上：流控型元件串联、压控型元件并联最方便。
- 有二极管时，等效特性也是分段的。例如二极管截止时，整条串联支路的电流都是零。

en.title: Nonlinear resistors in series and in parallel
text: - **Series**: the same current, voltages add. At the **same i**, add the curves' v values (stack them sideways): v = h_1(i) + h_2(i).
- **Parallel**: the same voltage, currents add. At the **same v**, add the i values (stack them vertically): i = f_1(v) + f_2(v).
- To add them as formulas the forms must match: current-controlled elements in series and voltage-controlled ones in parallel are the easy cases.
- With a diode the combined characteristic is piecewise too. For example, while the diode blocks, the whole series branch carries no current.

ideas.title: 曲线相交法（负载线）
text: - 电路里只有一个非线性电阻时，把**其余的线性部分**用戴维宁定理化成 V_oc 串 R_0。
- KVL 给出一条直线 v = V_oc − R_0·i，叫**负载线**。它过 (V_oc，0) 和 (0，V_oc/R_0)。负载线和特性曲线的交点就是**工作点 Q**。
- 线性部分有受控源也一样能化简，因为受控源是线性元件。但求 R_0 要用开路电压 / 短路电流，或外加电源法，**不能**把受控源置零。
- 求出 V_Q、I_Q 后用**替代定理**：把非线性电阻换成 V_Q 的电压源或 I_Q 的电流源，再回到原电路求别的支路。

en.title: Load-line (curve intersection) method
text: - With a single nonlinear resistor in the circuit, reduce **everything else** (the linear part) with Thevenin's theorem to V_oc in series with R_0.
- KVL then gives a straight line v = V_oc − R_0·i, the **load line**, through (V_oc, 0) and (0, V_oc/R_0). Where it crosses the characteristic is the **operating point Q**.

- Dependent sources in the linear part are fine, since they are linear elements. But find R_0 from the open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current, or with a test source; **never** zero a dependent source.

- Once V_Q and I_Q are known, use the **substitution theorem**: replace the nonlinear resistor by a V_Q voltage source or an I_Q current source and go back to the original circuit for the other branches.

ideas.title: 解析法：解非线性方程并检验根
text: - 特性有解析式时，把它代进负载线方程（或结点、回路方程），得到一个非线性代数方程。平方律特性得到的是一元二次方程。
- 解出的每个根都要**回代检查**：它在不在特性公式的适用范围里？例如 i = av² 只对 v ≥ 0 成立。
- 不在范围里的根不是工作点，舍去。在范围里的根可能不止一个，那就是多个工作点。

en.title: Analytic method: solve the nonlinear equation and check the roots
text: - When the characteristic has a formula, substitute it into the load-line equation (or the node or mesh equations). The result is a nonlinear algebraic equation; a square law gives a quadratic.
- **Check every root**: does it lie in the range where the formula holds? For example, i = av² only holds for v ≥ 0.
- A root outside the range is not an operating point; drop it. More than one root inside the range means more than one operating point.

ideas.title: 分段线性化法与理想二极管
text: - 把特性近似成几段直线。每一段都能写成 v = V_0k + R_k·i，也就是一个电压源串一个电阻：R_k 是这一段的斜率，V_0k 是延长线在 v 轴上的截距。它只在本段范围内有效。
- 方法是**先假设、再检验**：假设工作点在某一段，用对应的线性电路求解，再看结果是否真的落在这一段。不在，就换一个假设。
- **理想二极管**是最简单的两段特性。导通时 v = 0、i ≥ 0，像短路；截止时 i = 0、v ≤ 0，像开路。
- 再加上开启电压 V_on 和导通电阻 R_on，就是“理想二极管 + 电压源 + 电阻”的模型。面包板上的硅二极管正是这样：0.65 V 加 0.8 Ω。
- 有几个二极管时，逐个假设导通或截止，再检验：导通的管子电流 ≥ 0，截止的管子电压 ≤ V_on。

en.title: Piecewise-linear method and ideal diodes
text: - Approximate the characteristic by straight segments. Each segment is v = V_0k + R_k·i, a voltage source in series with a resistor: R_k is the segment's slope, V_0k where its extension meets the v axis. It holds only inside that segment.

- The method is **assume, then check**: assume the operating point lies on one segment, solve the matching linear circuit, then see whether the result really lies on that segment. If not, try another.
- The **ideal diode** is the simplest two-segment characteristic. On: v = 0, i ≥ 0, a short circuit. Off: i = 0, v ≤ 0, an open circuit.
- Add a turn-on voltage V_on and an on-resistance R_on and you have the "ideal diode + voltage source + resistor" model. The breadboard's silicon diode is exactly that: 0.65 V plus 0.8 Ω.
- With several diodes, assume each one on or off, then check: every conducting diode carries i ≥ 0, every blocking one has v ≤ V_on.

ideas.title: 多个工作点
text: - 特性不单调时，它和负载线可以有好几个交点。N 形曲线（隧道二极管）用电压源串电阻驱动，可能有三个工作点；S 形曲线也可能有多个。
- 工作点的个数随 V_s 和 R 变化。
- 哪个工作点真的会出现，要看**稳定性**。器件两端总有一点寄生电容 C，它看到的小信号电导是 1/R + 1/R_d：为正时扰动衰减（稳定），为负时扰动增长（不稳定）。
- 所以负阻段上的工作点在 |R_d| < R 时不稳定。这正是双稳态电路的原理。

en.title: Several operating points
text: - A non-monotonic characteristic can cross the load line several times. An N-shaped curve (a tunnel diode) driven by a voltage source and series resistor may have three operating points; an S-shaped curve can have several too.
- The number of operating points changes with V_s and R.

- Which one actually appears is a question of **stability**. There is always a little stray capacitance C across the device, and it sees a small-signal conductance 1/R + 1/R_d: positive, and a disturbance dies away (stable); negative, and it grows (unstable).
- So an operating point on the negative-resistance part is unstable when |R_d| < R. That is how bistable circuits work.

ideas.title: 小信号分析法
text: - 激励是直流 V_s 加一个很小的变化量 v_s(t) 时，响应 ≈ 直流工作点 + 小信号分量：v = V_Q + v_1，i = I_Q + i_1。
- 四步：**① 只留直流源**，求工作点 Q；**② 求 Q 点的动态电阻** R_d；**③ 画小信号等效电路**：直流源置零，非线性电阻换成 R_d，只留小信号源，求 v_1、i_1（正弦小信号可以用相量）；**④ 叠加**，得到总响应。
- 依据是特性在 Q 点的泰勒展开：f(V_Q + v_1) ≈ f(V_Q) + f'(V_Q)·v_1。信号足够小、曲线在这个范围里近似直线时，结果才准。
- 工作点在分段线性特性的某一段里、信号又不越过折点时，结果是精确的。
- 小信号电路里用的是 R_d，不是静态电阻。

en.title: Small-signal analysis
text: - When the excitation is a DC V_s plus a very small change v_s(t), the response ≈ DC operating point + small-signal part: v = V_Q + v_1, i = I_Q + i_1.

- Four steps: **① keep only the DC sources** and find Q; **② find the dynamic resistance** R_d at Q; **③ draw the small-signal circuit**: zero the DC sources, replace the nonlinear resistor by R_d, keep only the small-signal source and find v_1, i_1 (phasors for a sinusoidal signal); **④ add** to get the total response.
- The basis is the Taylor expansion at Q: f(V_Q + v_1) ≈ f(V_Q) + f'(V_Q)·v_1. It is accurate only when the signal is small enough that the curve is nearly straight over its range.
- When Q lies inside one segment of a piecewise-linear characteristic and the signal never crosses a corner, the result is exact.
- The small-signal circuit uses R_d, not the static resistance.

formulas.name: 压控型 / 流控型
formulas.when: v、i 取关联参考方向。f 为单值函数即压控型，h 为单值函数即流控型；单调特性两者都是。双向：f(−v) = −f(v)。

en.name: Voltage- / current-controlled
en.when: Passive sign convention. Voltage-controlled if f is single-valued, current-controlled if h is; a monotonic characteristic is both. Bilateral: f(−v) = −f(v).

formulas.name: 静态电阻
formulas.when: 工作点 Q 处，关联参考方向；I_Q = 0 时无定义。

en.name: Static resistance
en.when: At the operating point Q, passive convention; undefined when I_Q = 0.

formulas.name: 动态电阻
formulas.when: Q 点切线斜率的倒数（v–i 图上 v 为横轴时）；下降段 R_d < 0，水平段 R_d = ∞，竖直段 R_d = 0；折点处无定义。

en.name: Dynamic resistance
en.when: Reciprocal slope of the tangent at Q (v on the horizontal axis); R_d < 0 on a falling part, ∞ where horizontal, 0 where vertical; undefined at a corner.

formulas.name: 非线性电阻吸收的功率
formulas.when: 直流工作点处，关联参考方向。不能用 R_d 计算功率。

en.name: Power absorbed by a nonlinear resistor
en.when: At the DC operating point, passive convention. Never compute power with R_d.

formulas.name: 串联等效特性
formulas.when: 串联：各元件电流相同（同一个 i），电压相加；适合流控型（或单调）元件。

en.name: Series combination
en.when: Series: the same current i through each element, voltages add; suits current-controlled (or monotonic) elements.

formulas.name: 并联等效特性
formulas.when: 并联：各元件电压相同，电流相加；适合压控型（或单调）元件。

en.name: Parallel combination
en.when: Parallel: the same voltage across each element, currents add; suits voltage-controlled (or monotonic) elements.

formulas.name: 负载线
formulas.when: V_oc、R_0 是从非线性电阻两端看进去的线性部分的戴维宁参数；i 从 V_oc 的“+”端流出、流入非线性电阻（关联方向）。工作点：同时满足 i = f(v)。

en.name: Load line
en.when: V_oc, R_0: Thevenin parameters of the linear part seen from the nonlinear resistor; i leaves the "+" of V_oc and enters the nonlinear resistor (its passive convention). Operating point: i = f(v) at the same time.

formulas.name: 分段线性模型
formulas.when: 只在第 k 段的范围内成立；R_k 为该段斜率（动态电阻），V_0k 为延长线在 v 轴上的截距。解出后必须检验结果在该段内。

en.name: Piecewise-linear segment
en.when: Valid only inside segment k; R_k is its slope (dynamic resistance), V_0k the intercept of its extension on the v axis. Check that the solution lies in the segment.

formulas.name: 理想二极管
formulas.when: v 为阳极对阴极电压，i 从阳极流入。带开启电压时导通条件为 v = V_on + R_on·i、i ≥ 0，截止条件为 v ≤ V_on。

en.name: Ideal diode
en.expr: on: v = 0, i ≥ 0;  off: i = 0, v ≤ 0
en.when: v from anode to cathode, i into the anode. With a turn-on voltage: on means v = V_on + R_on·i with i ≥ 0, off means v ≤ V_on.

formulas.name: 工作点的稳定性（并联寄生电容）
formulas.when: 非线性电阻经串联电阻 R 接电压源、两端并联寄生电容 C 时：小信号电路是一阶 RC 电路，τ = C/(1/R + 1/R_d)，τ > 0 稳定。

en.name: Stability of an operating point (parallel parasitic capacitance)
en.when: Nonlinear resistor driven by a voltage source through R, with a parasitic capacitance C across it: the small-signal circuit is first-order RC with τ = C/(1/R + 1/R_d); stable if τ > 0.

formulas.name: 小信号近似
formulas.when: |v_1|、|i_1| 足够小，使特性在 Q 附近近似为直线；v_1、i_1 由小信号等效电路求得（直流源置零，非线性电阻 → R_d）。

en.name: Small-signal approximation
en.when: |v_1|, |i_1| small enough that the characteristic is nearly straight around Q; v_1, i_1 come from the small-signal circuit (DC sources zeroed, nonlinear resistor → R_d).

formulas.name: 线性化的依据
formulas.when: 压控型 i = f(v)，在 Q 点一阶泰勒展开，忽略 v_1 的高次项；f'(V_Q) = G_d = 1/R_d。

en.name: Why linearisation works
en.when: Voltage-controlled i = f(v), first-order Taylor expansion at Q, higher powers of v_1 neglected; f'(V_Q) = G_d = 1/R_d.

examples.title: 戴维宁化简 + 负载线：平方律电阻的工作点
examples.statement: 图示电路中 V_s = 9 V，R_1 = 3 Ω，R_2 = 6 Ω，非线性电阻 N 的特性为 i = 0.5v²（v ≥ 0；v < 0 时 i = 0）。求工作点、R_1 中的电流、N 的静态电阻和动态电阻。
steps: 2. **负载线。** v = 6 − 2i，在特性图上是过 (6 V，0) 和 (0，3 A) 的虚线。
3. **解析求交点。** 代入 i = 0.5v²：v = 6 − v² → v² + v − 6 = 0 → (v − 2)(v + 3) = 0。v = −3 不在 v ≥ 0 的范围内（那里 i = 0，负载线却要求 i = 4.5），舍去：**V_Q = 2 V，I_Q = 2 A**，与图中的交点 Q 一致。

en.title: Thevenin reduction + load line: operating point of a square-law resistor
en.statement: V_s = 9 V, R_1 = 3 Ω, R_2 = 6 Ω; the nonlinear resistor N has i = 0.5v² (v ≥ 0; i = 0 for v < 0). Find the operating point, the current in R_1, and the static and dynamic resistances of N.
steps: 1. **Reduce only the linear part.** Remove N: V_oc = 9 × 6/(3 + 6) = **6 V**; short V_s: R_0 = 3 ∥ 6 = **2 Ω**.
2. **Load line.** v = 6 − 2i, the dashed line through (6 V, 0) and (0, 3 A) on the plot.

3. **Intersect analytically.** With i = 0.5v²: v = 6 − v² → v² + v − 6 = 0 → (v − 2)(v + 3) = 0. v = −3 is outside v ≥ 0 (there i = 0 while the load line needs i = 4.5), so it is rejected: **V_Q = 2 V, I_Q = 2 A**, the point Q on the plot.
4. **Back to the original circuit (substitution theorem).** v_a = V_Q = 2 V, **i_1 = (9 − 2)/3 ≈ 2.333 A**; R_2 carries 2/6 ≈ 0.333 A, KCL: 0.333 + 2 = 2.333 ✓.
5. **The two resistances.** Static R = 2/2 = **1 Ω**; dynamic di/dv = v = 2 S, **R_d = 0.5 Ω**. Power P_N = 2 × 2 = **4 W**.

examples.title: 小信号分析：流控型电阻
examples.statement: 直流 V_s = 4 V 与小信号源 v_s(t) = 0.05cos(100t) V 串联，经 R = 2 Ω 给非线性电阻 N 供电，N 的特性为 v = i + i²（i ≥ 0；i < 0 时 v = 0）。求 N 的电压 v(t) 和电流 i(t)。
steps: 2. **动态电阻。** 流控型直接求导：R_d = dv/di = 1 + 2i = **3 Ω**（静态电阻 R = 2/1 = **2 Ω**，两者不同）。
5. **检查（两次精确求解作差）。** 把 V_s 分别改为 4 + 0.05 V 和 4 − 0.05 V 精确求解 i² + 3i = V_s，两次电流之差的一半与 **I_1m = 0.01 A** 相差不到 0.01% ✓。若在第 3 步误用静态电阻 R = 2 Ω，会算出 V_1m = 0.05 × 2/4，偏小。

en.title: Small-signal analysis of a current-controlled resistor
en.statement: A DC source V_s = 4 V in series with a small-signal source v_s(t) = 0.05cos(100t) V feeds the nonlinear resistor N through R = 2 Ω; N has v = i + i² (i ≥ 0; v = 0 for i < 0). Find N's voltage v(t) and current i(t).
steps: 1. **DC operating point (v_s = 0).** KVL: 4 − 2i = i + i² → i² + 3i − 4 = 0 → (i − 1)(i + 4) = 0; i = −4 violates i ≥ 0 and is rejected: **I_Q = 1 A, V_Q = 2 V**.
2. **Dynamic resistance.** Current-controlled, so differentiate directly: R_d = dv/di = 1 + 2i = **3 Ω** (the static resistance R = 2/1 = **2 Ω** is different).
3. **Small-signal circuit.** Short V_s and replace N by R_d = 3 Ω: v_1 = v_s·3/(2 + 3), **V_1m = 0.03 V**; **I_1m = 0.05/5 = 0.01 A**.
4. **Total response.** v(t) ≈ 2 + 0.03cos(100t) V, i(t) ≈ 1 + 0.01cos(100t) A.

5. **Check (difference of two exact solutions).** Solve i² + 3i = V_s exactly with V_s = 4 + 0.05 V and 4 − 0.05 V: half the difference of the two currents agrees with **I_1m = 0.01 A** to better than 0.01 % ✓. Using the static resistance R = 2 Ω in step 3 would give V_1m = 0.05 × 2/4, too small.

mistakes.text: 在小信号等效电路里用静态电阻 V_Q/I_Q 代替非线性电阻。增量之间的比例是切线斜率 R_d = dv/di|_{Q}，不是 Q 与原点连线的斜率。

en.text: Using the static resistance V_Q/I_Q in the small-signal circuit. Increments are related by the tangent slope R_d = dv/di at Q, not by the slope of the line from the origin.

mistakes.text: 把直流和交流分量“叠加”当成精确结果，或者把非线性电阻也化成戴维宁电路。叠加定理和戴维宁定理只适用于线性部分；小信号分析是 Q 点附近的线性近似，信号大了就不准。

en.text: Treating DC + AC superposition as exact, or reducing the nonlinear resistor to a Thevenin circuit too. Superposition and Thevenin apply to the linear part only; small-signal analysis is a linear approximation around Q and fails for large signals.

mistakes.text: 解出二次方程后两个根都保留，或者随手取正根而不检验。每个根都要代回带适用范围的特性（如 i = av² 只对 v ≥ 0）和电路方程；有时两个根都合理，那就是两个工作点。

en.text: Keeping both roots of the quadratic, or taking the positive one without checking. Substitute each root into the characteristic with its range (i = av² only for v ≥ 0) and into the circuit equations; sometimes both pass, and then there are two operating points.

mistakes.text: 分段线性化时只解方程、不检验交点是否落在所设的段内；二极管电路里假设了状态却不检查导通管的电流方向和截止管的电压。

en.text: Solving a piecewise-linear segment without checking that the result lies inside it; in diode circuits, assuming states without checking the current of conducting diodes and the voltage of blocking ones.

mistakes.text: 线性部分含受控源时，把受控源置零后用串并联求 R_0。受控源要保留，用开路电压/短路电流或外加电源法。

en.text: Zeroing a dependent source in the linear part and finding R_0 by series–parallel reduction. Keep the dependent source; use open-circuit voltage / short-circuit current or a test source.

mistakes.text: 默认工作点只有一个。压控型的 N 形特性、流控型的 S 形特性与负载线可能有三个交点；先画图数交点，再逐个求。

en.text: Assuming the operating point is unique. An N-shaped voltage-controlled or S-shaped current-controlled curve can cross the load line three times; sketch and count the intersections first.

mistakes.text: 用动态电阻算功率（P = R_d·I_Q²），负动态电阻时还得出“发出功率”。非线性电阻吸收的功率是 V_Q·I_Q。

en.text: Computing power with the dynamic resistance (P = R_d·I_Q²), and concluding that a negative R_d means power is delivered. The power absorbed is V_Q·I_Q.

intro: This chapter covers nonlinear **resistive** circuits only. The equations are no longer linear and superposition fails; the linear part can still be reduced with Thevenin's theorem.
Everything revolves around the **operating point**: find it by curve intersection (the load line), analytically or piecewise-linearly, then use the dynamic resistance for small-signal analysis.
The habit that matters most: check every solution against the range where the characteristic holds.
